Alana: Kickoff for Crossbeam case study + launch webinar. Need interview with Head of Ops, a short benchmark stat for the blog, pull quote signoff, and legal embargo date. Can we land by next Friday?

Noah: I can schedule 20m slots Wed/Thu. Suggest Wed 10:00 PT for Head of Ops. Sending Calendly now.

Rachel: For the benchmark, small throughput run on their anonymized e2e prompts. I'll deliver median latency and one comparative line. Need customer permission to run tests.

James: Asset needs: final quote, 2 headshots, company logo, and a 30s testimonial clip for social. I'll mock hero image drafts.

Alana: Draft pull quote: 
```
"Redwood cut inference times so our ops team can deliver faster insights to partners."
```

legal-bot: Edit suggestion: add attribution and avoid absolutes. Recommend: "In our tests, Redwood reduced inference times in our environment, helping us deliver insights to partners faster." Review window 48-72h.

Alana: Updated per legal. Customer asked for embargo until the 18th. Can legal confirm quick review?

legal-bot: We can review copy and the single-line benchmark (with appendix link). Marking priority; expect clearance within 48h if no redlines. Also ensure consent copy on webinar form.

Rachel: Perf run scheduled Thu 07:30 PT. Will post stat + appendix link here.

ops-bot: Routing set: utm_campaign=crossbeam_launch; tag=crossbeam-case; leads -> /queues/enterprise-sdr. Consent param captured. :gear:

James: Uploaded draft hero and placeholder social frames. Holding until final quote + headshots.

Noah: Calendly accepted by Head of Ops for Wed 10:00 PT. I'll attach recording/transcript after interview.

Alana: Thanks everyone. Action list: schedule (Noah), perf (Rachel), legal signoff (legal-bot), assets (James), lead routing (ops-bot). Following up Mon AM.
